title: Secondary Sale and Assignment Agreement
introduction: This Secondary Sale and Assignment Agreement (the “Agreement”) is between the seller identified below (the “Seller”) and the purchaser identified below (the “Purchaser”). The issuer of the interest being sold is identified in the transaction details (the “Issuer”). The Seller and Purchaser are each a “Party” and together the “Parties”. The Parties agree as follows.

sections.heading: 1. Transferred Interest and Governing Documents
paragraphs: The “Transferred Interest” means the quantity or portion of the identified source position specified in the transaction details, together with the rights that accompany that interest under the Governing Documents and are transferable with it. The “Governing Documents” means the executed instrument, constitutive documents, transaction agreements, amendments, and side letters that govern the Transferred Interest, including those identified in the Governing documents field. The Parties incorporate those documents by reference to the extent applicable to the Transferred Interest.

The Parties acknowledge and agree that the Governing Documents continue to determine the nature and terms of the Transferred Interest. This Agreement supplies the terms of its secondary sale and does not amend those documents, reset the original investment terms, or exercise or convert an instrument. The Governing Documents control over an inconsistent description in this Agreement or in a Ledger Entry Token (a “LET”). Closing is conditioned on resolving any discrepancy affecting the proposed transfer; each Party shall cooperate in the applicable amendment or correction procedure.

A partial transfer includes only the identified portion and the rights and obligations attributable to it under the Governing Documents. A division of LET units does not by itself divide a contractual entitlement. The Parties shall specify any additional allocation or permitted carve-out necessary to identify the Transferred Interest in Special terms before Closing. A personal or otherwise nontransferable right passes only if identified in Special terms and the required authorization is obtained. The Seller retains the untransferred portion subject to the Governing Documents and applicable law.

sections.heading: 2. Sale and Closing
paragraphs: The Seller shall sell and the Purchaser shall purchase the Transferred Interest for the consideration and on the payment and closing terms specified in Purchase terms. The “Closing” occurs when the agreed consideration and Transferred Interest have been delivered and the applicable transfer requirements under Section 3 have been satisfied. Effective at Closing, the Seller hereby assigns the Transferred Interest to the Purchaser, and the Purchaser hereby accepts that assignment.

For a sale through a posted offer, the “Offer Record” means the identified offer on the selected chain and DealManager; the “Settlement Record” means the particular acceptance recorded by that DealManager and its agreement registry. The Seller authorizes permitted fills on the Offer Record’s quantity, payment, expiry and purchaser terms, subject to this Agreement and the Governing Documents. The gross consideration for a fill is the amount the Offer Record requires for that fill. Before posting, the Seller shall review the offered quantity, payment token, price, disclosed fees and resulting net-proceeds basis, and authorizes permitted fills on that basis without a separate confirmation for each fill. Before accepting, the Purchaser shall review its fill quantity, payment token, gross consideration and disclosed fees. A separate seller approval is required only if expressly included in the offer conditions or Special terms. Neither Party shall impose an undisclosed fee or payment adjustment on the other. A display in another currency does not change the agreed consideration.

A named-purchaser sale is limited to the agreed purchaser; an eligible-buyer link permits purchases by persons meeting the applicable offer and transfer conditions. Neither Party shall treat a link or a descriptive wallet address as a technical access restriction. A Purchaser shall confirm that it meets the offer restrictions before accepting. The Seller authorizes eligible purchasers under those restrictions; any separately required purchaser approval remains a condition of Closing. Cancellation of an unaccepted remainder does not cancel an accepted settlement.

Each Party shall bear its own transaction costs and taxes, except as otherwise expressly agreed in Purchase terms or Special terms or required by law. Each Party shall supply tax information and perform withholding, remittance and reporting required of it by law. No Party assumes another person’s taxes or a gross-up obligation by implication. The Parties shall arrange any required withholding before funding and shall not use settlement mechanics that cannot implement it.

sections.heading: 3. Continuing Obligations and Transfer Requirements
paragraphs: Effective at Closing, the Purchaser assumes the obligations attaching to the Transferred Interest under the Governing Documents to the extent binding on a successor holder, and agrees to be bound by the applicable restrictions. The Purchaser shall execute any required joinder in the capacity specified by the applicable agreement. The Seller remains responsible for its prior breaches and accrued liabilities unless the person entitled to enforce them expressly releases it. No release or novation is implied, and this Agreement does not limit a liability imposed by applicable law.

Each Party’s obligation to close is conditioned on the other Party’s representations being accurate at Closing and on satisfaction of the applicable consents, rights of first refusal, co-sale procedures, lockups, joinders, admission requirements and legal requirements. Each Party shall take the steps required of it to satisfy those conditions and shall notify the other of an unmet condition before funding or finalization. Neither Party is required to waive a condition. Special terms may record transaction-specific conditions or authorized exceptions; a blank field does not waive the Governing Documents.

The Seller shall supply complete copies of the Governing Documents in its possession or control before the Purchaser adopts this Agreement, including amendments and side letters affecting the Transferred Interest. The Parties shall retain those copies with this Agreement. A document reference is not a representation that the application has retrieved or attached its contents. Each Party shall use authorized private delivery for nonpublic documents.

The Issuer becomes bound only by an acknowledgment or joinder it separately authorizes. A protocol approval does not by itself make the Issuer a party or waive a third person’s rights. For an LLC interest, admission as a member and the exercise of membership or management rights remain subject to the operating agreement and applicable law. Each Party shall obtain any required issuer recognition and record update; possession of a LET alone establishes neither membership admission nor the legally definitive ownership record.

sections.heading: 4. Representations and Restrictions
paragraphs: Each Party represents and warrants to the other, as of adoption and Closing, that it has capacity and authority to enter into and perform this Agreement and has authorized its signing and receiving wallets in the stated capacity. The Seller further represents and warrants that it owns and may transfer the Transferred Interest, has not previously disposed of or encumbered it except as disclosed and accepted in Special terms, and has not knowingly omitted a governing amendment or side letter in its possession or control.

The Purchaser represents and warrants that it has received and reviewed the Governing Documents and is acquiring the Transferred Interest for its own account or in its disclosed authorized capacity, without a view to a distribution in violation of applicable law. The Purchaser acknowledges the applicable transfer restrictions and legends and the risk of losing its investment. The Seller makes no representation of the Issuer’s future value or solvency except as expressly stated in Special terms.

Each Party shall comply with the requirements applicable to its actual resale transaction. Neither Party shall treat a primary issuance exemption, a credential check, or technical transferability as establishing compliance for this sale. Nothing in this Agreement waives fraud claims or a right, duty, or liability that applicable law does not permit the Parties to waive.

sections.heading: 5. Electronic Adoption and Technology
paragraphs: Electronic adoption through the protocol applies only when the Offer Record and Settlement Record identify this exact registered agreement version and contain the agreed transaction and party values. In that case, the Seller adopts the Agreement by authorizing the posting transaction, and the Purchaser adopts it by authorizing the registry signature and acceptance transaction for its Settlement Record. Each person acting for another represents and warrants that it has authority in the identified capacity. Preparing, viewing or downloading a draft, or signing a transaction using another registered agreement, does not adopt this Agreement. Registered transaction and party values may be publicly readable; each Party shall review and authorize that disclosure before submission and use authorized private delivery for nonpublic source documents.

Neither Party shall initiate settlement through a mechanism that cannot deliver the agreed interest and preserve the entitlements required by the Governing Documents. A draft, metadata entry or issuer acknowledgment does not establish technical compatibility. The Parties acknowledge that acceptance may escrow payment before finalization and that a transaction receipt does not establish satisfaction of an unrecorded legal condition.

If an agreed closing cannot lawfully complete, including because of expiry, a contract failure, a chain disruption or a private-key compromise, each Party shall cooperate in lawful cancellation or recovery and return property received without entitlement. The Parties shall use available authorized recovery procedures; no automatic reversal or new administrative power is created by this Agreement. Required authority and the treatment of competing chain records remain governed by the Governing Documents. Neither Party shall use a split, replacement or recovery to duplicate an entitlement. If Closing has not occurred by the agreed expiry or outside date, either Party may terminate the unclosed transaction by notice, without releasing accrued liability or cancelling an accepted settlement that remains subject to its authorized cancellation or recovery process.

sections.heading: 6. Technology Provider
paragraphs: The Parties acknowledge that MetaLeX provides technology and is not a Party, issuer, seller, broker, dealer, underwriter, agent, fiduciary or counterparty to this sale. Neither Party shall represent that MetaLeX has approved the transaction, verified the underlying legal rights or guaranteed settlement or investment performance. MetaLeX is an express third-party beneficiary of this Section 6 only. Nothing in this Section excludes a liability that applicable law prohibits excluding.

sections.heading: 7. General Provisions
paragraphs: The law identified in Governing law governs this Agreement, without its conflict-of-laws rules. The law governing the Issuer’s internal affairs and the Governing Documents continues to govern their respective subject matter. Each Party shall cooperate and execute further documents reasonably necessary to complete the authorized transfer.

This Agreement and the Governing Documents constitute the agreement of the Parties on this transfer. The Parties may amend this Agreement only by a writing adopted by both of them, without amending a Governing Document or binding another person without the authorization it requires. As between the Parties, Purchase terms and Special terms control over an inconsistent standard provision of this Agreement, but do not override the Governing Documents or a third person’s rights. Each Party shall send notices to the other Party’s stated notice contact; a notice is effective on receipt. If a provision is unenforceable, the remaining provisions continue to apply to the extent permitted by law.

References to an interest include its applicable class or series. References to documents include their applicable amendments. “Including” introduces examples without limiting the preceding words. Headings do not affect interpretation. No ambiguity is construed against a Party solely because it supplied the form.

exhibits.heading: Transaction Details
exhibits.text: Identify the interest and this sale. The Governing Documents supply the existing instrument terms; summaries and metadata do not amend them. Supply the identified documents with this Agreement through authorized delivery.

fields.label: Issuer
fields.helpText: Identify the issuer of the position.

fields.label: Source position
fields.helpText: Identify the existing position or instrument, including its LET reference if available.

fields.label: Instrument type
fields.helpText: Identify the type and applicable class or series. Its terms remain in the governing documents.

fields.label: Amount being sold
fields.helpText: Specify the units or exact portion being assigned. Add a special allocation only if needed for this transfer.

fields.label: Purchase terms
fields.helpText: Review price, payment token, buyer or link mode, and expiry. Record any separately agreed payment or closing terms here.

fields.label: Governing documents
fields.helpText: Identify and supply the executed instrument and applicable governing agreements, amendments and side letters. Use document titles, dates and stable references; do not restate their terms. If later registered, submitted values may be public; keep nonpublic documents in authorized private delivery.

fields.label: Governing law
fields.helpText: Defaults to the issuer’s jurisdiction of formation or incorporation when available. You can choose a different governing law for this sale agreement.

fields.label: Special terms (optional)
fields.helpText: Only transaction-specific exceptions, conditions or allocations. Leave blank for the standard transfer provisions. If later registered, submitted values may be public; keep nonpublic documents in authorized private delivery.
